name: Pantoprazole
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Lower rilpivirine exposure, loss of antiviral effect and resistance (label).
Raised INR and prothrombin time; bleeding (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor INR; adjust warfarin as needed.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Drugs needing gastric acid for absorption (iron salts, ketoconazole, itraconazole, erlotinib, dasatinib, nilotinib, mycophenolate mofetil)
key_interactions.action: See the other drug's prescribing information.

key_interactions.effect: No clinically important effect on clopidogrel's active metabolite (label).
